issue_title: Integrate Twilio WhatsApp API for Customer Messaging & Work Triage
issue_description:
Task Room REST API Blocked Finding Report:

The request to 'Integrate Twilio WhatsApp API for Customer Messaging & Work Triage' (Issue #26196) involves adding a new channel and harness adapter (Twilio/WhatsApp) to the One Human Corp repository.

According to the OneHumanCorp operating contract and the active business-capability map in `RESEARCH.md` (revision 2026-09-18-usage-audit), integrating additional channels or harnesses requires explicit, retained-customer need, measurable value, and explicit strategy approval. Specifically, the 'Gated expansion' policy states that 'Additional channels, industry packs, accounting integrations, physical operations, HR/payroll, POS, manufacturing, marketplaces and more harnesses' require explicit expansion decisions and evidence.

The current `RESEARCH.md` does not mention Twilio or WhatsApp as an approved channel or target integration. Therefore, this issue represents an unauthorized feature expansion.

This task is classified as a [blocked finding]. No implementation will be performed, and this task is concluded as a no-work outcome.
